name: Hornero Studio Audio
description: Audio Extensions 2.0: bar indicator, popover and dashboard card for the Studio audio mode and Temporary Performance state from the typed horneroctl contract. Read-only; mode changes stay in the CLI and Control Center.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Audio Extensions 2.0: compact indicator with host-owned popover and dashboard card (mode, Temporary Performance, read-only output state, refresh), typed refreshSeconds/showWhenUnavailable settings, Theme tokens, host-context layout and Spanish catalog. Still read-only over the typed horneroctl studio contract.
Bar indicator for the Studio audio mode and Temporary Performance state; stacked caption so the mode code does not clip in the bar.

refreshSeconds.description: Seconds between studio mode refreshes from horneroctl.

showWhenUnavailable.description: Keep the bar indicator visible, labelled as unavailable, when horneroctl returns no usable studio mode.
